# Engineering Blue 1 — 2026-2027 Schedule

*Captured from the live `Red Blue 2627 Calendar` Google Sheet (Schedule tab), re-cut 2026-09-19, Engineering Blue 1 column, split out from the combined calendar so this thread only sees its own course's dates.*

For which cycle day (`R1`/`R2`/`B1`/`B2`) falls on a given date, and for holidays and breaks, see the shared calendar: `shared/nhs-information/red-blue-2026-2027-schedule-calendar.md`.

**Do not edit this file from a course thread.** Scheduling belongs to the Life
Planning project, which re-cuts every `CALENDAR.md` from the `Red Blue 2627
Calendar` sheet and writes the dated tasks in Things 3. A course project builds
and deploys material; it reads this file and does not change it. See
`shared/nhs-information/course-material-layers.md`.
